statements.t: We expect to share topline data from the Phase 2b portion of the study in the second quarter of 2027, representing the first data readout from any placebo-controlled trial of people with dilated cardiomyopathy.

Tonlamarsen is an investigational antisense oligonucleotide that targets hepatic angiotensinogen (AGT) for the management of blood pressure in patients with acute severe hypertension (ASH) post-hospitalization.
